mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_id, status, current_run_id, max_steps, max_tool_calls, max_duration_seconds, max_no_progress_rounds, created_at, updated_at FROM investigation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, incident_id, status, current_run_id, max_steps, max_tool_calls, max_duration_seconds, max_no_progress_rounds, created_at, updated_at FROM investigation WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, incident_id, status, current_run_id, max_steps, max_tool_calls, max_duration_seconds, max_no_progress_rounds, created_at, updated_at FROM investigation WHERE status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','INCONCLUSIVE','FAILED','CANCELLED','WAITING_FOR_HUMAN')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investigation (incident_id, status, current_run_id, max_steps, max_tool_calls, max_duration_seconds, max_no_progress_rounds) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{status}, #{currentRunId}, #{maxSteps}, #{maxToolCalls}, #{maxDurationSeconds}, #{maxNoProgressRounds})
mapper.update: UPDATE investigation SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE investigation SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','INCONCLUSIVE','FAILED','CANCELLED','WAITING_FOR_HUMAN')
UPDATE investigation SET current_run_id = #{currentRunId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
